name: Rider
source:
One of the Twelve Paladins of Charlemagne. As a Rider servant, his mount is a Hippogriff. His Noble Phantasm is Trap of Argalia, which can disable any living thing with a touch. 

[spoiler]His true identity is Astolfo.[/spoiler]
